note: A core fit, though on an unconventional profile. He is not a business owner or physician but he is self-employed and living off professional online poker, with a separate office and international travel — the 'or equivalent' clause covers him, and the rep read it correctly ('it sounds like you're doing quite well, if you're actually living off of that'). Income is not in doubt: $6,000 accepted in a single exchange with no plan requested and no financial conversation at all, alongside a planned trip to Dallas to see a specialist about his back. Neglected health is close to verbatim ICP — everything else in his life is working and 'I just wasn't taking care of myself'. Good to great is his own framing and it points past his former self rather than back to it: 'I just want to be in the best shape of my life.' And he plainly clears the exclusion: boxing three times a week, walking daily, already eight days into keto with an eight-hour eating window, roughly 11 kg above his normal weight rather than 50 lb overweight, and about as far from gym-averse as the corpus gets. The useful comparison is with the Omar call the previous day, the batch's other core fit, who did not buy. Both matched every criterion; one closed in seconds and one walked over proof and method comparison. That difference had nothing to do with ICP fit and everything to do with the prospect arriving pre-sold on the modality — Javier had watched Trevor's videos, understood why kettlebells, and had already been injured by the generic alternative.
